visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with dark, wet hair is shown in a close-up view looking directly into the camera. She has a neutral, focused expression and is wearing a dark blue shirt with a light brown towel knotted around her neck. The background shows a brightly lit, modern interior with mirrors and wooden accents typical of a professional hair salon. Colorful star and heart filters frame the view. (2) The video transitions to show the hair treatment process. A stylist's hands, clad in black gloves, are seen applying white product to the woman's hair. Her head is partially covered with plastic wrap and a circular heating device is active behind her. She remains still, occasionally glancing at the camera, while the surrounding salon environment remains softly blurred in the background with warm, artificial lighting. (3) The final transformation is revealed, showing the woman with beautifully styled, dark brown wavy hair and neat bangs. She smiles brightly and appears confident. The lighting emphasizes the shine of her new hair. For a brief moment, another woman in a light pink top enters the frame from behind her, smiling and displaying a peace sign, celebrating the successful makeover in the well-lit salon setting.
